description: This Java source file defines the class ContactsFilterInstrumentation, which extends android.app.Instrumentation. It implements instrumentation testing functionality for an Android activity, specifically starting an activity and simulating key events to test filtering functionality.

classes.name: ContactsFilterInstrumentation
classes.description: A custom instrumentation class for testing an Android activity by automating activity startup and simulating key events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the instrumentation object and starts the test logic in a separate thread.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts the target activity, simulates key presses to filter a list, waits for processing to complete, and then finishes the test.
